chunks: So watch for the day when the sky begins to emit clear smoke,
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the 'clear smoke' mentioned in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this 'clear smoke' (Dukhan Mubin) is often interpreted as a specific cosmic sign preceding the final resurrection, sometimes linked to the minor signs of the Hour or the period of the Minor Occultation. The verse emphasizes divine warning, urging believers to prepare spiritually as this visible phenomenon signals the imminent culmination of earthly trials.
